entries.title: Psalms 91:1
segments: ¶He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. {abide: Heb. lodge}

entries.title: Psalms 91:2
segments: I will say of the LORD, [He is] my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

entries.title: Psalms 91:3
segments: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, [and] from the noisome pestilence.

entries.title: Psalms 91:4
segments: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth [shall be thy] shield and buckler.

entries.title: Psalms 91:5
segments: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; [nor] for the arrow [that] flieth by day;

entries.title: Psalms 91:6
segments: [Nor] for the pestilence [that] walketh in darkness; [nor] for the destruction [that] wasteth at noonday.

entries.title: Psalms 91:7
segments: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; [but] it shall not come nigh thee.

entries.title: Psalms 91:8
segments: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 91:9
segments: ¶Because thou hast made the LORD, [which is] my refuge, [even] the most High, thy habitation;

entries.title: Psalms 91:10
segments: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

entries.title: Psalms 91:11
segments: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

words.text: For he shall give his angels

entries.title: Psalms 91:12
segments: They shall bear thee up in [their] hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

entries.title: Psalms 91:13
segments: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet. {adder: or, asp}

entries.title: Psalms 91:14
segments: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

words.text: Because he hath set his love
upon me, therefore will I deliver
him: I will set him on high

entries.title: Psalms 91:15
segments: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I [will be] with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

words.text: upon me, and I will answer
him: I [will be] with him in trouble

entries.title: Psalms 91:16
segments: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation. {long...: Heb. length of days}
